Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with anxiety over the past few months.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: I've been feeling really anxious over the past few months.

Chief_Complaint.content: Feels very nervous every morning about leaving the house.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: I just get really nervous every morning about leaving the house

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Symptoms began about two months ago.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I would say maybe about two months or so, I've been feeling like this

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Onset coincided with starting a new job.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: and that probably coincides with, me starting a new job

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Work has been very stressful over the past two months.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: it's been really stressful I think over the past two months, definitely.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Has never worked in retail before.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I've never worked in retail before

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports boss is not very nice to her.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: my boss is not very nice to me

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Dreads going to work.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I just really dread, going there.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Worried about whether she is doing well at work.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: really worried about whether I'm doing well or not.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Anxiety is impacting sleep.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: And it's really impacting on like, on the rest of my life, like my sleep and stuff like that.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Goes to bed at about 10–11 pm.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: About ten, eleven, probably.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Has difficulty falling asleep and lies awake for a long time.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Not for ages, I'm, I'm lying awake all night

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Wakes before the alarm with a racing heart and panic about being late.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: So I find my, my heart kind of racing, and then I'm just like panicking that I'm gonna be late

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Recently thought she might have a heart attack due to racing heart in the morning.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I was lying in bed and I really thought my heart was racing so much, I thought I was gonna have a heart attack in the morning.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Estimates sleeping only three to four hours per night.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: maybe, three, four hours, I'm getting now.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: No significant changes in appetite.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No I wouldn't say that, I wouldn't say that I'm eating like, much differently.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Eating more chocolate than usual because she feels down.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I probably have more chocolate than normal, just because I feel, so down.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Eating regularly.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Yeah, .

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Palpitations occur in the morning when she fears being late after oversleeping.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: it's, it's usually kind of like, when I realise in the morning that, either um, I feel like I'm gonna be late, because I've like overslept 'cause I'm so tired.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Palpitations described as a constant rapid heartbeat.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: it's just kind of like, just a constant like, rapid heart beating.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Unsure if palpitations are due to stress or a heart problem.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I don't know if it's, stress or if, , or I did think it was like, a heart problem really actually.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Palpitations feel irregular.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Irregular, I think.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Palpitations last from a couple of minutes up to about ten minutes.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: it can be anything, I think couple of minutes, or the other day I was actually just, sort of lying there for like, holding my hand on my chest for like ten minutes.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Palpitations have been occurring only for the past couple of months.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I would say this is only in the past. Sort of like, couple of months as I say that I've been, experiencing this.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports pain when the heart is beating fast.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No, um, well yeah it's painful to , when the heart, when my heart is beating fast but, but, yeah.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Daytime energy is very low.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: It's just, really, really low,

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports no enjoyment in day-to-day activities.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I find no enjoyment at all.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Previously enjoyable activities are no longer enjoyable.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: anything that, previously was, really fun is just not, it's not enjoyable.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Feels on edge all the time.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: And I'm like, yeah, on edge the whole time.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Avoids seeing friends because she expects not to enjoy it.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I know that I'm not gonna have fun, because I don't want to, go out and, do things that I would normally have done.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reduced participation in running and tennis.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I did used to like to like go running, and. And to play tennis and stuff, but now it's just not, I'm just not enjoying it, I'm not, I'm not like, I'm not going out to do that quite so much.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Has not missed work despite symptoms.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No, 'cause I think that would just add to the tension

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Thinks most mornings about calling in sick or not going to work.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: but I do like pretty much every morning I think, ohh I should call in sick or like, just not go.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies having had a panic attack.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No I wouldn't say so,

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Has always managed to make it to work.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I think, I've always managed to make it to work.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Public transport, especially the tube, is very stressful.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I find public transport really stressful anyway, especially being on the tube

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Most anxiety is focused around work.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: the majority of it is focused around work as well.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: No previous episodes as bad as the current one.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I've never felt, anything this bad before.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Feels constantly a bit down and unhappy, including at weekends.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: even at the weekends and stuff it's just the, kind of like constant, feeling of just being a bit, down, a bit unhappy.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Denies suicidal thoughts.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I haven't had any suicidal thoughts or any, thoughts that have been that extreme

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Has not sought counseling or other help before this GP visit.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I did talk to my mum about it but I haven't sought any, she recommended that I come to the GP, um, but I haven't sought any other.

Family_History.content: Mother has a history of depression.
Family_History.source_text: my mum, because she also suffers from, well she's , suffered from like depression in the past.

Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I live with my parents, just my parents.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Reports having a good family support system.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I have, I have a good support system, like I do have good family and stuff.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Probably exceeds her alcohol limit on Fridays or Saturdays.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I probably go over my limit just on those days, anyway

Social_and_Family_History.content: May have a glass of wine during the week.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: and then like, maybe a glass of wine during the week .

Social_and_Family_History.content: Does not keep track of alcohol consumption.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: I guess I don't really keep track of it that much.
I try not to smoke, but I do, occasionally

Assessment.content: Palpitations are most likely associated with anxiety.
Assessment.source_text: in terms of palpitations, it is most likely to be a, , associated with anxiety

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient to self-refer via the NHS for talking therapy.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: you can self-refer via the NHS, for what we call like, talking therapy

Plan_of_Care.content: Doctor will send the link for the self-referral.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: so I can send you the link for that.

Plan_of_Care.content: Provide online resources to start working through immediately.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: There are some online resources that are really helpful. Um, can put the details, on there and you can, get on with them straight away

Plan_of_Care.content: Medication for anxiety is not suggested initially.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: some people, with anxiety they, do need to take medication to control that but that's, not something that we'd suggest in the first instance.

Plan_of_Care.content: Doctor will add information about improving sleep patterns to the notes.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: And I'll put some more information on your notes about, helping with your, sleep patterns and things like that.

Plan_of_Care.content: Arrange a couple of basic blood tests to check for triggers of palpitations.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: it's probably worth having couple of basic blood tests just to make sure that, there's not something triggering that off.

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient to call the support line to arrange the blood tests.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: So if you call the support line you can arrange the, to have the blood test done.

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient is willing to have one-to-one therapy.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Yeah I think, yeah I think so. I've never done that before, but yeah.

Follow_up_Information.content: Return call if therapy is not helping or anxiety worsens to the point of being unable to cope with work or normal day-to-day activities.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: if you're feeling like it's not helping at all, or your anxiety is getting worse, to the point where you can't cope with work, or you can't, just do your normal things day-to-day. Then, it's important for us to, for you to give us a call, back and just discuss that, further.

Follow_up_Information.content: Arrange a GP follow-up one week after having the blood tests to review results.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: then arranging a GP follow-up a week after you've had the tests, so we can just go through the results with you.
